question: Gangubai Hangal was an Indian vocalist of Hindustani classical tradition who was awarded the Sangeet Natak Academy Award in 1973. From which of the following musical Gharanas did she belong ?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Kirana Gharana__**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kirana Gharana**__ is the name of this school of music derives from Kirana or Kairana, a town and tehsil of Shamli District in Uttar Pradesh.
